title: One-Pot Creamy Tuscan Chicken
description: Seared chicken breasts simmered in a garlicky cream sauce loaded with sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, and Parmesan. One pot, minimal cleanup, maximum weeknight satisfaction.

steps.text: Season chicken breasts on both sides with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat until shimmering. Sear chicken until golden on each side but not cooked through — about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium. Add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant but not browned, about 30 seconds.
Add sun-dried tomatoes and chicken broth. Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan — that's flavor. Bring to a simmer.

Stir in heavy cream and red pepper flakes. Return chicken to the pan, nestling it into the sauce. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until chicken registers 165°F internally, 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove chicken to serving plates. Stir spinach into the sauce in handfuls — it wilts down fast. Once wilted, stir in Parmesan until the sauce is smooth and glossy, about 1 minute.
Spoon sauce generously over the chicken. Serve with crusty bread or over rice to catch every drop.
